title: Norris et al. 2024 replication and matched-task agent comparison
status: Public-code reconstruction authorized after disclosure of cohort mismatch; no exact paper reproduction claimed

primary_reproduction.split: 3 training folds, 1 validation fold, 1 test fold; no shared patients
primary_reproduction.training_limit_caveat: Ten epochs in Appendix D describe tuning; the example notebook says its 10-epoch final training differs from the paper's early stopping. The 1000-epoch ceiling follows released train_model default and is an explicit reconstruction assumption.
primary_reproduction.hyperparameters: Use exact full-precision values in the released notebook; do not tune to match test results.
primary_reproduction.primary_metric: AUROC per patient, averaged within fold, then across the 25 held-out folds
primary_reproduction.thresholds: Report Appendix C median/MAD and released-code pooled Youden separately.
primary_reproduction.pass_criteria: All 75 runs complete, counts reconciled, no leakage, preprocessing/model checks pass. Report numerical differences; closeness alone is not proof of exact reproduction.

additional_paper_results.channel_sensitivity: Reuse held-out Transformer checkpoints at 1,2,4,9,18,37,74 channels. Bootstrap patients, not individual electrodes or repeated folds as independent cases.
additional_paper_results.spatial_example: Predetermine lowest-ID eligible test patient in seed 1; no selection by model success.
additional_paper_results.outcome_analysis: Requires independently verified Engel labels and the exact modified model specification. Do not manufacture outcomes from SOZ or resection labels.
additional_paper_results.hyperparameter_search: The paper reports a separate 10-trial search per primary model. A run with published selected hyperparameters is a fixed-configuration replication, not a rerun of the search.

agent_comparison.task: Rank the same held-out patient's eligible electrodes by SOZ likelihood, given measured SPES responses and frozen numerical tools.
agent_comparison.order: Start only after all 75 public-code reconstruction runs complete; compare on that identical frozen cohort, explicitly distinguishing it from the paper cohort.
agent_comparison.tools: All strategies share the same out-of-fold trained models, waveform features, distances and calibration learned from validation patients.
strategies: four specialists with shared board, two rounds
agent_comparison.LLM_budget: 8 requests per held-out patient per agent strategy, same model, output cap and observations; failed calls count; no unrecorded retries.
agent_comparison.evaluation: Patient-level paired AUROC differences; cluster uncertainty by patient across repeats; record API usage and wall time.
agent_comparison.labels: SOZ, resection and outcome annotations, patient identity, test accuracy and reference prevalence must never appear in agent payloads.
agent_comparison.reflection: Critique only model disagreement, observed response features and earlier proposals; no test-label feedback.
agent_comparison.separate_extension: Budgeted next-stimulation selection is a later extension, not an exact replication of the paper's classification task.

known_reproduction_gaps: Original public preprocessing yields 35 patients, 2145 electrodes and 304 SOZ positives, versus published 35/2066/298. Do not delete contacts to force agreement.
Original notebook does not publish training RNG states, file/set ordering, exact fold manifests or trained checkpoints.
torch==2.1.0.dev20230724 is replaced by released torch==2.1.0+cu121; record the compatibility difference.
Original threshold evaluation disagrees with Appendix C; preserve and report both instead of hiding the difference.
Outcome-specific labels and modified-model details must be verified before claiming every paper figure reproduced.
language: English reports, README, protocol and code comments
